direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px Header / 52px GuideStrip / minmax(0,1fr) / 56px DecisionBar; cols 184px StepRail / minmax(0,1fr) FactoryStage / 360px EvidenceInspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before shrinking type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A on #050705, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text as the owner-required exception; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular quantities, time and cost; enlarge stage labels under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; visible 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries second and final logo placement; StepRail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; GuideStrip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and DecisionBar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge SVG machine and route labels to 11px minimum; RECEIVING HOLD state is clear but sublabels compete with the 120 versus 80 tracks.
Refit inspector evidence list so both source records are fully visible at 1366x768 without clipped third-row peek.
Strengthen bidirectional highlight: selecting ev-cert-qty or ev-recv-qty should outline the matching quantity track and machine node.
Keep Route health pre-flight and Investigation source evidence as separate labelled groups with independent status lines; do not merge their controls or completion state.
Make the route selector and Run Sample investigation dependency explicit: disabled or explained until a route choice is confirmed.
Enlarge the small offline note under Route health to 12px and add a text status icon equivalent for reduced-motion and non-color reading.
Preserve selected-path opening of the typed consent form; keep Accept disabled until the exact phrase matches and announce match state via aria-live.
Reduce plan identifier verbosity in the consent panel; show short plan label first and full identifier on focus or in a secondary line.
Add visible focus ring to each Select this path control equal in prominence to the typed input ring.
Keep proposed tasks visually dashed and labelled UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL until Approve is pressed; do not show tracked styling or progress markers.
Refit the stage route labels 40 via CELL-MILL-1 and 30 via CELL-MILL-1 so they do not overlap the recovery flow line.
Give the inspector task list a clear internal scroll cue and 36px row targets for keyboard selection.
Make preview versus applied state unmistakable: CELL-MILL-2 preview should use silver dashed outline only, reserving red stopped styling for after Apply second shock.
Enlarge CELL-MILL-1 and CELL-MILL-2 capacity text in the inspector to 13px and align ONLINE and PREVIEW tags on one baseline.
Move Scenario Management admin action lower or mute it further so the invalidating primary remains the sole dominant action.
Retain owner-required red only on stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; ensure no route is drawn through that cell.
Keep pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity separate from the reinvestigation evidence task, with its own heading, status and Run control.
Mark Split available capacity as constrained with pattern plus text in the SVG chips, matching the inspector state.
Preserve fresh typed consent for the revised plan; keep Accept revised decision disabled until exact phrase matches and prior acceptance is shown as invalidated.
Make the constrained Split option non-selectable with a clear reason and no pointer style, while retaining its tradeoff row for comparison.
Tighten the revised-plan summary to one line so the phrase label and input remain visible without inspector scroll at 768px height.
Keep 3 blocked prior tasks and 3 proposed replacement tasks as separate groups; label replacements UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL and prior tasks BLOCKED beside the approved revised plan.
Refit the stacked inspector groups so both group headings and Decline proposal remain visible without relying on faint scroll edges.
Add pattern or marker difference beyond color for blocked prior rows versus dashed proposed rows in both board and SVG legend.
Sequence Verify ledger, separate passphrase sealing, and independent checkpoint as gated steps with text status for each, not color alone.
Clarify passphrase rule in one concise sentence near the input and show character-count feedback without exposing entered content.
Reduce repeated small helper lines under each evidence step; keep one status sentence per step to fit the inspector at 768px.
Keep completion state read-only: disabled Verify and checkpoint controls should retain Complete text markers and remove pointer style.
Make PACKET SEALED summary in the DecisionBar the single completion announcement, with aria-live polite and no duplicate primary action.
Ensure the final stage retains red only on CELL-MILL-2 and neon only on the accepted feasible route through CELL-MILL-1.
